label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_01
text: Thank you for coming to the Coastal Plaza to\nchallenge me.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_06
text: And...I really am sorry for the way I protested\nyou joining the BB League, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_07
text: Of course, it’s true that this is quite irregular\nunder the bylaws of our school clubs.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_08
text: But mainly I didn’t want you to get dragged into\nthe drama that’s been troubling the club lately.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_09
text: I suppose our trial has already officially begun,\nthough, so let’s get to it and have some fun![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_02
text: The trial that I came up with is...a [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Pokémon quiz[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_03
text: I’ll ask you five questions about Pokémon. If you\ncan answer them all correctly, then you pass![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_04
text: Are you ready to attempt my Pokémon quiz,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_01
text: All right, here we go! And look—it’s everyone’s\nfavorite Pokémon, Pikachu, here to help![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_02
text: And with that...question one![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_15
text: Pikachu is an Electric-type Pokémon well known\nfor producing electricity within its body.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_03
text: But in which part of its body does it store the\nelectricity it generates?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_04
text: Go right for the body part that you think is\ncorrect![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_05
text: [EMPTY 127]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_06
text: Ding ding ding! You got it!\c\nPikachu stores its electricity in the electric sacs\nin its [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]cheeks[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_07
text: If you poke the sacs, you’ll get a little shock, but\ndon’t you think they’re just super round and cute?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_08
text: Now then...I think we’re ready to move on to\nour next quiz question![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

text: Hmm?! Oh no, what a shame—but that’s not the\nright part at all![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

text: I’ll give you a hint: the part you’re looking for is\na different color from the rest of Pikachu’s body.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_11
text: Hmm?! Really?! No, no, I’m afraid that’s still the\nwrong part of poor Pikachu.\c\nAnd that’s two strikes, which means...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_14

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_01
text: Take a look at Venonat here! It’s bigger than\nyou’d think it would be, isn’t it? But it’s also fluffy\r\nand squeezable and terribly adorable, really![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_02
text: So here we go with question two![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

text: What part of Venonat’s body acts like radar?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_08
text: Now then...I think we’re ready to move on to\nour next quiz question![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_09
text: Hmm?! Oooh, that’s close...but incorrect! I do\nsee why you’d think that, though![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

text: I’ll give you a hint: what we’re looking for is quite\na large part of Venonat’s body. Now guess again![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

text: Getting weary of my quiz? How about a cup of\ntea—or maybe these three Sinistea siblings?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

text: Here’s question three![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz03_05

text: Now then...I think we’re ready to move on to\nour next quiz question![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

text: Hmm?! Oh, no no no. That’s not the right one.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

text: This is the Meteor Pokémon, Minior! It comes\nin all kinds of different colors, you know.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
